data.name: Nava
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Nava means new. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'nawah' which means rest or repose. In the Bible, Nava is mentioned in Numbers 26:51 as one of the daughters of Zelophehad who challenged the patriarchal law and gained the right for women to inherit land.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nava is a reflection of the transformative power of God. In the biblical story of Nava and her sisters, their challenge to the patriarchal law paved the way for a new understanding of God's love and justice. Nava serves as a reminder that through faith, we can challenge the status quo and strive for a deeper connection with God and each other.
